title: nan
authors: López E.; García S.; Barea R.; Bergasa L.M.; Molinos E.J.; Arroyo R.; Romera E.; Pardo S.
key_contribution: Presents a multi-sensorial SLAM system for low-cost micro aerial vehicles in GPS-denied indoor environments, integrating vision, laser, and inertial measurements via EKF, validated experimentally.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Filter_Based_VIO to ensure precise positioning.
